comparison.objective: Roll pastry into a long, even 3 mm sheet.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual leveling and repeated rolling of deformable material using spacer rings.
comparison.success_condition: Specified sheet length, thickness uniformity and cross-width evenness; rolling pin safely set down and released.
comparison.reason: Tests distributed deformation and thickness control, whereas the candidate tests precision transfer of a rigid recirculating-bearing block across a continuously supported interface.
